title: 第5章 要证据吗第6章 真正的掌公主
slug: 绑定生子系统后我御兽封神
content_zh:
“宋荞，你在说什么？你疯了吗？”楚风眠有些难以置信地看着宋荞。
宋荞看也懒得看他一眼，直接说道：“大家都知道，这楚风眠原本是要入赘我们宋氏的。我看他一开始还算老实，便也配合着和他玩一玩。
没想到，我人太好，倒是将他纵得骄狂了。他竟敢不守夫道，背着我和林颜眉来眼去！
这也就罢了，他竟还敢吃里扒外！我这灵兽蛋，好好放在我的洞府中，门口还有诸多法阵守护，林颜和我素无交情，她如何能进入？我身边，定然是出了内贼！”
宋荞停顿了一下，面无表情地说道：“能够随便进入我洞府的，除了爷爷，也就只有楚风眠。灵兽蛋被偷，此事并非林颜一人能够做成。楚风眠，才是那个带路贼。”
众人纷纷看向楚风眠。
楚风眠的脸色顿时涨得通红，他厉声说道：“宋荞，你知道你在说些什么吗？”
林颜一时都有些恍惚。宋荞……她竟敢这么对楚风眠说话。
她疯了吗？
“小荞，你这是……”宋方一时都懵了。
宋荞平日里对楚风眠有多么维护，他最清楚不过。
他一开始收下楚风眠这个徒弟时，对他和宋荞的事情，是乐见其成的。
但林颜来了之后，宋方也发现自己这个弟子变得有些不对劲，他私下去敲打了楚风眠。
结果，这事情被宋荞知道了，当场就是一阵大闹，还因此十天半个月不理他。
他已经没有了儿子儿媳，不能再没有这个孙女。
宋方只能小心翼翼哄着孙女，之后也不敢再说楚风眠什么。
他想着，只要他在一天，楚风眠就得老实一天。
既然孙女喜欢楚风眠，他总是要让她如愿的。
但现在……
宋荞好像自己突然就想通了？

“宋荞，我再给你一次机会，收回你的这些话！否则……”楚风眠神情阴沉。
宋荞看了他一眼，直接打断了他：“否则什么？否则你就没人吸血了？”
宋荞看向掌门：“掌门，楚风眠和林颜，联手偷盗灵兽蛋。两人皆是贼，我请求掌门公平执法，给两人应有的惩戒。”
林颜眸光一动，水汽立刻上来了：“宋师姐，这灵兽蛋，明明是你非要给我的。现在你却突然这么说……我不知道我是哪里得罪了你，让你这般陷害我。”
“陷害你？”宋荞讽刺地看了一眼林颜：“用一个高级灵兽蛋来陷害你？林颜，你也配！”
林颜的表情不由僵硬住了。
楚风眠不由有些心疼了起来，他沉声说道：“好了，宋荞，你不要再无理取闹了。我说了，我和林颜清清白白，没有你想的那种关系。你跟我私下闹也就算了，你在掌门面前还这般闹，未免有些过分了。”
楚风眠一脸无奈地说道：“掌门，宋荞从小娇生惯养，养成了大小姐脾气。我和林颜不过多说了几句话，她就心生醋意，甚至不惜用高级灵兽蛋来陷害林颜！要不是霸天虎意外和林颜绑定了生死契约，林颜怕是早就被强行解除契约了。到时候，宋荞照样能得回灵兽，根本不会损失什么。
宋荞是我师妹，我本该替她隐瞒的。但是……她这行为着实不妥，我也是不想让她一错再错，才站出来帮林颜说话的。”
林颜更是一脸倔强地看着掌门：“难道，就因为她是大长老的孙女，就可以一手遮天，陷害无辜了吗？”
陈戈看了看楚风眠，又看了看宋荞，淡然说道：“大家都知道，楚风眠和宋荞从小一起长大，感情甚笃。连楚风眠都这般说了，此事看来……是不会有假了。”
他和宋方素来不合，只要是给宋方添堵的事情，他都不介意做上一做。
宋荞看着这两人演戏，唇角泛起一丝冷笑来。
掌门看着她：“宋荞，你可有什么进一步的证据？”
宋荞没有回答，她只是看向了宋方，然后轻声说道：“爷爷。楚风眠，我真的不要了。”
楚风眠愣了一下，有些恼怒：“宋荞，你……”
content_en:
"Song Qiao, what are you talking about? Are you crazy?" Chu Fengmian looked at Song Qiao in disbelief.
Song Qiao didn't bother to look at him and said directly: "Everyone knows that Chu Fengmian was originally going to marry our Song family. I saw that he was quite honest at the beginning, so I cooperated and played with him.
Unexpectedly, I am such a nice person that I make him arrogant. How dare he break the rules of a husband and flirt with me and Lin Yan behind our backs!
That's all, he actually dared to eat it inside and out! My spirit beast egg is placed in my cave, and there are many magic circles guarding the door. Lin Yan and I have never been friends, how can she enter? There must be a thief around me! "
Song Qiao paused for a moment and said expressionlessly: "Besides Grandpa, the only one who can enter my cave is Chu Fengmian. The spirit beast egg was stolen, and it was not something Lin Yan could do alone. Chu Fengmian is the thief who leads the way."
Everyone looked at Chu Fengmian.
Chu Fengmian's face suddenly turned red, and he said sharply: "Song Qiao, do you know what you are talking about?"
Lin Yan was in a daze for a moment. Song Qiao... How dare she speak to Chu Fengmian like this.
Is she crazy?
"Xiaoqiao, what are you..." Song Fang was stunned for a moment.
He knew best how much Song Qiao protected Chu Fengmian.
When he first accepted Chu Fengmian as his disciple, he was happy to see the outcome of his and Song Qiao's affairs.
But after Lin Yan arrived, Song Fang also found that something was wrong with his disciple, so he went to beat Chu Fengmian in private.
As a result, Song Qiao found out about this and made a fuss on the spot, and ignored him for ten days and a half.
He no longer has a son or daughter-in-law, and he can no longer live without his granddaughter.
Song Fang could only coax his granddaughter carefully, and did not dare to say anything to Chu Fengmian after that.
He thought that as long as he was here, Chu Fengmian would have to be honest.
Since his granddaughter likes Chu Fengmian, he will always make her wish come true.
But now...
Song Qiao seemed to have suddenly figured it out?
"Song Qiao, I'll give you one more chance to take back your words! Otherwise..." Chu Fengmian looked gloomy.
Song Qiao glanced at him and interrupted him directly: "Otherwise what? Otherwise you won't have anyone to suck blood from?"
Song Qiao looked at the leader: "Master, Chu Fengmian and Lin Yan teamed up to steal the spirit beast eggs. Both of them are thieves. I ask the leader to enforce the law fairly and give them the punishment they deserve."
Lin Yan's eyes moved, and moisture immediately came up: "Senior Sister Song, you obviously insisted on giving me this spirit beast egg. But now you suddenly say this... I don't know where I offended you and let you frame me like this."
"Frame you?" Song Qiao glanced at Lin Yan sarcastically: "Frame you with a high-level spiritual beast egg? Lin Yan, you deserve it!"
Lin Yan's expression couldn't help but stiffen.
Chu Fengmian couldn't help but feel a little distressed. He said in a deep voice: "Okay, Song Qiao, don't make unreasonable troubles anymore. I told you that Lin Yan and I have a clean relationship and don't have the kind of relationship you think. It's okay for you to make trouble with me in private. It's a bit too much for you to make such trouble in front of the leader."
Chu Fengmian said helplessly: "Master, Song Qiao has been pampered since childhood and has developed the temper of a young lady. Lin Yan and I only exchanged a few words, but she became jealous and even used high-level spirit beast eggs to frame Lin Yan! If the Decepticons hadn't accidentally bound Lin Yan to a life-and-death contract, Lin Yan would have been forcibly terminated. By then, Song Qiao would still be able to get the spirit beast back and would not lose anything at all.
Song Qiao is my junior sister, I should have concealed it for her. But...her behavior was really inappropriate, and I didn't want her to make the same mistake again and again, so I stood up to speak for Lin Yan. "
Lin Yan looked at the leader with a stubborn look on her face: "Could it be that just because she is the Grand Elder's granddaughter, she can cover up the sky with one hand and frame the innocent?"
Chen Ge looked at Chu Fengmian and then at Song Qiao, indifferentlySaid: "Everyone knows that Chu Fengmian and Song Qiao grew up together and have a very close relationship. Even Chu Fengmian said this. It seems that... there is no lie in this matter."
He and Song Fang had never gotten along, and he didn't mind doing anything that would cause trouble for Song Fang.
Song Qiao watched the two people acting with a sneer on his lips.
The leader looked at her: "Song Qiao, do you have any further evidence?"
Song Qiao didn't answer. She just looked at Song Fang and said softly: "Grandpa. Chu Fengmian, I really don't want it anymore."
Chu Fengmian was stunned for a moment, a little angry: "Song Qiao, you..."
